content.text:
I removed the coloured priority stripe (DEC-008 no longer applies), so red now only marks overdue todos. Each todo now shows its priority as plain grey text ("High", "Med", "Low").
Why the label: without the stripe, a todo's priority would only show in its sort position. The priority setting, `data-priority` and the sort order are unchanged.
Rejected: removing the colour with no label, and any other colour scheme.
